sources.content_coverage: Every visible object page in the orders and medals/decorations trees
sources.coverage_result: 63/63 object pages processed; 81/81 exposed images cached. Twenty-five pictured grade/type rows in 19 source families and 47 unique complete views were promoted. Thirty-eight named pages remain unpictured, including one page whose only illustration could not be established as an official or historical plate.

sources.coverage_result: 17/17 linked award-family pages processed and 46/46 non-filtered images cached. After rejecting ribbon-only files and deduplicating against MedalBook, 15 rows were created, 6 prior rows upgraded, 9 net rows and 5 net families added with 27 local views.

sources.source_name: Wikimedia Commons — North Korea orders and medals category tree
sources.coverage_result: Category traversal is complete: 10 categories and 140 file pages inventoried. Eleven rasters are cached; 95 original-image requests were rate-limited with HTTP 429. Four checked rows were created, one prior row upgraded, three net rows and two net families added. Exact duplicates, ribbon-only graphics and a related honour badge were excluded from the state-award main catalogue.
